summary.result: The findings of this study revealed that soil conditioners (PAM and gypsum) could play a significant role in controlling soil erosion.
summary.background: Experimental erosion plots individually sized $10m^2$ (5 m long, 2 m wide and 1 m deep) have different slopes (10, 20 and 30%).
summary.method: The amount of sediment loss from a control plot was 399.2 ton/ha and the relative reduction of sediment loss were 11.4% and 33.4% for PAM-treated and PAM+gypsum treated plots, respectively.
